query: UPDATE abuse_flag SET resolved_at = $2::timestamptz, resolved_by = $3, action = $4, action_reason = $5, mail_requested_at = CASE WHEN $6::bool THEN $2::timestamptz END, mail_due_at = CASE WHEN $6::bool THEN $2::timestamptz END, mail_attempts = 0, mail_sent_at = NULL, mail_error = NULL WHERE id = $1
